title: Sleep only partly works
line: On 7840U and newer GPD handhelds sleep drains the battery and the system hibernates after about 5 %. Turn it off for long breaks.
symptom: Suspend only partly works on GPD handhelds with a 7840U or newer; the firmware wakes it as the battery drops and Bazzite hibernates it.
why: A firmware and graphics-driver problem on the 7840U and newer GPD boards; no software workaround is known.
undo: Nothing to undo: this is advice, GameCove changes nothing.
bazzite: Not fixed; documented on Bazzite's GPD page (upstream drm/amd issue 3154).

probe.what: Nothing on the device can tell; the nightly audit watches the reports.

watch.note: WIN 4 wakes about every two hours on battery.
Bazzite's GPD page: the sleep note going away means it's fixed.
